metaDescription: Order custom workwear with your logo. Safety vests, jackets, aprons, and more. Bulk pricing and fast turnaround. Get a quote today.
introHtml:
Marketing directors ordering giveaway apparel for a trade show, HR directors outfitting an employee onboarding kit, and safety managers equipping a crew with high-vis gear all need workwear that performs. Whether it's a Signal Hi-Vis Jacket for a construction team or a 10 oz Cotton Apron for a brewery launch, the right custom workwear keeps your team safe and your brand visible. Business owners also turn to this category for durable, logo-printed pieces that last through daily wear.

This collection covers everything from Safety Tees and Mechanics Gloves to COB Headlamps and Nylon Reflective Snap Bands. You can decorate each item with screen printing, embroidery, or heat transfer to match your company colors and logo. Bulk orders keep per-unit costs low, making it easy to outfit large teams or hand out promotional gear at events. Browse the products below and see how custom workwear can work for your next program.
buyingGuideHtml:
When buying custom workwear, focus on durability, safety compliance, and decoration options. Look for materials that withstand frequent washing and job-site abuse. For high-vis items like the Signal Hi-Vis Jacket, check that they meet ANSI/ISEA 107 standards for visibility. For aprons, choose cotton or polyester blends that resist stains and fraying. Quality zippers, reinforced seams, and adjustable closures add longevity.

Materials and Build Quality

Cotton aprons (like the 10 oz Cotton Apron) offer breathability and a soft hand, while polyester blends add wrinkle resistance. For safety vests and jackets, lightweight polyester with reflective tape is standard. Gloves should have padded palms and reinforced fingertips. Headlamps need weather-resistant housings and bright LED output. Always request material samples before placing a large order to verify feel and fit.

Common Use Cases

Safety managers stock high-vis vests and hard hats for construction crews. HR directors include logo-printed aprons or safety glasses in employee welcome kits. Marketing directors give branded headlamps or earplug sets at outdoor trade shows. Business owners order bulk workwear for company uniforms, ensuring a professional look across all teams. Custom workwear also works for volunteer events, charity runs, and community cleanups.

Decoration and Customization

Screen printing works well on T-shirts and aprons, offering vibrant colors at low cost per piece. Embroidery adds a premium feel on jackets and aprons, especially for logos with fine details. Heat transfer is ideal for small runs or full-color designs. For reflective gear, avoid covering reflective tape with ink; instead, print on non-reflective panels. Laser engraving can mark hard hats and metal tools. Always check the decoration method against the fabric to prevent cracking or peeling.

Quantity Guidance and MOQ

Most workwear items have a minimum order quantity (MOQ) of 12 to 48 pieces, depending on the product. T-shirts and aprons often have lower MOQs, while jackets and specialized safety gear may require higher quantities. Ordering above the MOQ lowers the per-unit price significantly. For large teams, consider a single design across multiple items to simplify production. If you need samples, many suppliers offer one-off decorated samples for a fee.

Common Buying Mistakes

One frequent error is ordering the wrong size range. Always provide a size chart and ask employees to measure themselves. Another mistake is overlooking safety standards: verify that high-vis gear meets applicable ANSI ratings. Also, avoid choosing a decoration method that compromises the item's function (e.g., thick embroidery on a lightweight safety vest may cause discomfort). Finally, factor in lead time: custom workwear can take 2-4 weeks, so plan ahead for events or seasonal needs.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom workwear?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product. T-shirts and aprons typically have MOQs of 12-24 pieces, while jackets and safety vests may require 24-48 pieces. Contact us for specific MOQs on the items you need.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer samples. You can order a blank sample to check material and fit, or a decorated sample with your logo for a small fee. This helps ensure you're satisfied before committing to a large run.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best for workwear?
faqs.a: Screen printing is cost-effective for T-shirts and aprons. Embroidery adds a professional look on jackets and aprons. Heat transfer is good for full-color logos. For high-vis items, avoid covering reflective tape with ink.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom workwear?
faqs.a: Typical production time is 2-4 weeks after art approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Always plan ahead for events or seasonal needs to ensure timely delivery.

faqs.q: Do you offer sizing for both men and women?
faqs.a: Yes, many workwear items come in unisex sizing, but we also carry women-specific fits for items like T-shirts and vests. Check the product page for available size ranges and consult our size chart.
